outline: Observed trade-offs and negative circuit repair
Failed calibration and pending human/confirmatory evidence

paragraph_roles.opening: State the research question and the narrow central finding, not the website pitch.
paragraph_roles.challenge: Refusal restoration may coexist with over-refusal and task-performance loss.
paragraph_roles.method: Define compared model states, distinguish edit supports and separate measurement paths.
paragraph_roles.evidence: Show the recorded comparison and paired task-performance interval.
paragraph_roles.limitation: Keep uncalibrated harm estimates, pending human labels and unexecuted confirmation explicit.
paragraph_roles.release: Link public evidence and reproduction without exposing the private submission form.

claim_evidence_map.claim: Sparse repair retains more GSM8K strict-match performance than the full-support repair under the evaluated conditions.
Both compared repairs have higher recorded benign over-refusal than the drifted model.
The evaluated circuit-restricted edit does not improve judged harm rate over drift.
Harm estimates are not verified safety results; human calibration and confirmatory work remain pending.
Successful production safety repair, general capability preservation or superior matched-budget circuit targeting.
claim_evidence_map.evidence: Not established by the current evidence

self_review.contribution: pass_for_exploratory_study: claim is measured trade-offs and a negative targeted-repair outcome, not a novel guaranteed safety mechanism
